translations.web: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.
translations.bsb: But when they hand you over, do not worry about how to respond or what to say. In that hour you will be given what to say.
translations.kjv: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
translations.asv: But when they deliver you up, be not anxious how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that hour what ye shall speak.
